title: Metric-driven self-learning loop ①–⑥ — CODE-COMPLETE (dormant, uncommitted)
summary: The 6-node metric-driven optimization loop (this session dd7f0a33/1–6) is built, tested, and on disk in ~/.claude/orchestrator, all UNCOMMITTED and DORMANT until a :8787 restart. ① target-repo decoupling (resolveRepo, set_task_repo). ② inline metric-spec (overlay.metrics, set_task_metric). ③ measure node (lib/measure.js, measure_task, baseline+guardrails). ④ competitive-benchmark (overlay.benchmarks, set_task_benchmark + self-learn-benchmark skill, never fabricates). ⑤ metric-aware judge (self-learn-judge SKILL.md: weighs metric improvement vs baseline + guardrail-regression near-veto + benchmark gap; merges via merge_attempt→target repo; verdict carries machine-readable improvement fields; back-compat to rationale). ⑥ optimize-loop control (lib/optimize.js decideOptimize: converged(target)>stuck(K no-winner→request_guidance)>converged(diminishing returns ε)>budget>iterate; mechanical/deterministic; nothing auto-cancels/replans; config optimize.epsilon=0.01, diminishing_rounds=3). Tests: optimize 31, smoke 83, full unit suite green across all six.
